I followed 'in the order the areas are listed' (areas listed [59,144], [62,163], [76,126] -> cubes [55,145], [58,163], [72,126]) but the recorded list is [[72,126],[55,145],[58,163]]: the green cube at the [76,126] area comes first. The instruction must state the actual ordering key, e.g. sort the highlighted cubes by x ascending (robot's right-most first: 126, 145, 163) or by distance to the gripper/button side, rather than by the order the areas are printed.
critique.missing_from_policy_prompt_for_subgoal: On the button-press step it says to point at the first entry of the list just written, so the choice of cube is entirely determined by the memory ordering; it should state independently which highlighted cube to pick first (the one with the smallest x / nearest the robot's right, here the green cube at [72,126]) so the pick order does not silently depend on the listing order of the highlighted areas.
